freeze: Independent scratch-only scientific mixed-AI oracle, frozen before mixed product/native implementation or reading. Hand-declared ABI arguments and IEEE words; no product encoder, SDK, driver, native call, compiler or runtime.
scope: Scientific quantities/units/constructor selection and scan-major raw values are independent of future JSON naming. Proposed public row/config/protocol names are recorded separately as boundaries, not used to derive words.
task_profile: one fresh owned analog-input task; all selected channel measurements are AI, not mixed I/O types
constructor_abi_sources: All fixed constructor signatures/types and constants remain in six immutable prior oracles; no variadic getter/setter, conversion or unqualified new ABI is added.

ordered_four_channel_constructor_control.terminal_request: omitted, driver default unqueried, no terminal setter

selected_exports.rule: Resolve only union of constructors actually requested plus chosen timing common functions BEFORE CreateTask. Missing selected symbol has no task effect; missing unselected constructors never blocks.
selected_exports.tc_terminal_setter: Resolve DAQmxSetAITermCfg only if at least one TC channel explicitly requests nondefault terminal; apply immediately after that TC constructor, before next channel. No setter for RTD or other families.

same_family_override_control.profile: explicit mixed with two voltage channels is valid, no mandatory two-kind rule
same_family_override_control.rule: Do not copy one task-global range/terminal into both columns.

actual_channel_contract.query: Validate TaskNumChans and bounded1-based NthTaskReadChannel; normalize individual names and require exact requested order before Start.
reject: missing per-channel kind or unrequested fields
actual_channel_contract.ordinal: zero-based output column identity is attached to the actual ordered read-channel vector, not guessed solely from constructor order

two_scan_four_column_control.layout: scan_major; each scan visits ordered actual read channels0,1,2,3
two_scan_four_column_control.on_demand_rule: Two software attempts concatenate to exactly the same two-scan words. Positive original remaining timeout and worker HOST attempt/frontier pacing follow immutable on-demand oracle; no exact physical-entry gap law.

negative_valid_prefix_control.rule: One complete scan in actual channel order precedes original failure and optional diagnostics; never publish second unreceived scan or lose valid prefix to diagnostic hang.

scientific_rules.tc_and_rtd: Shared finite temperature field is not shared sensor kind or shared unit; column1 is TC Celsius, column3 RTD Fahrenheit. Their first25.0 words are identical, not locally converted.
scientific_rules.nonfinite: Preserve complete raw IEEE word/sign/payload, omit only the finite numeric quantity key; no JSON null or zero substitution.
scientific_rules.signed_zero: Voltage column0 second scan is negative zero; finite numeric roundtrip and raw bits retain its sign.
scientific_rules.no_global_unit: Each column owns its constructor quantity/units; a task-wide F64 buffer has no global volts/temperature/amperes interpretation.
scientific_rules.excitation: RTD external1/512A is an operator-supplied input-excitation declaration, not a source created by Capturefab. An internal variant can energize sensor; neither variant is physical hardware qualification.
scientific_rules.r0: R0=1000ohms always refers to sensor resistance at0C despite RTD output Fahrenheit.
scientific_rules.legacy_builtin_current: Existing249.0 filler convention remains only immutable ABI behavior for builtin shunts, never measured resistance or implicit metadata.

lifecycle_and_limits.setup: One owned Task, requested per-channel constructors in order, selected optional TC setter, exact actual channel count/order, selected timing then Start. A later constructor failure cleans that one task, no acquisition from partial setup, fallback, restart, reset or task splitting.
lifecycle_and_limits.status: Retain positive warnings and negative first cause exactly; data and raw native Read code precede deferred optional diagnostics.
lifecycle_and_limits.finish: No Read. Existing bounded Stop/Clear ownership and diagnostic cleanup; original deadlines/cutoff, post-Read completion clocks and accepted queued prefix unchanged.
lifecycle_and_limits.repeats: Retain repeats including documented slow-module duplicates; no simultaneous-conversion, unique-freshness, sample-loss or cross-module hardware skew claim.
lifecycle_and_limits.source_time: omitted; no per-column physical timestamps invented
lifecycle_and_limits.bounds: 1..64 ordered channels;4096 F64 words;96 notices;512KiB private/public row and1MiB existing batch. Worst-case mixed serialization requires meaningful proof before a fitting-capacity claim.

future_contract_boundary.public_selection: measurement:mixed with required per-channel measurement tag and typed family fields; allow same-family differing requests; old homogeneous config/rows unchanged
future_contract_boundary.column_metadata: one ordered channel_measurements array with zero-based channel_index, actual physical, measurement kind, quantity, units and existing family request/provenance fields
future_contract_boundary.word_metadata: no repeated kind tags per word; finite keys are selected by column, raw bytes authoritative
future_contract_boundary.not_scientific_input: These names describe future integration only; scientific bit/argument controls above were independently declared.

primary_provenance.read_f64_and_per_constructor_units: Exact fixed ReadAnalogF64 and constructor unit contracts are pinned by immutable six prior ABI/oracles. The scaled-per-channel interpretation composes those documented contracts.
primary_provenance.independent_reads: Reviewer independently reopened C-Series multiCreate/different-units/slow-repeat, scaledF64 and interleaving pages. Mixed-task KB returned502 to this reviewer; its7.3 historical claim is from the accepted plan author, not independently re-read here.

qualification: Synthetic pre-product scientific/ABI composition oracle only. No named device/driver/chassis/OS, multi-device mixed task, synchronization, physical excitation, conversion freshness or hardware measurement is qualified.
